notes: Calendar page: uses the full width (no empty column on the right)
“Line up days of the week in the 3-month views” – tick or untick it and the picture underneath shows the difference straight away

Categories, much simpler, and the same on every calendar page: one row each – name, colour, as a line, shown, and how it will look. General categories first, then the people ones (Family, then your groups with their people underneath, then anyone not in a group)
A category that isn’t shown goes in Other; Other itself can now be switched off. The separate key editor has gone – the key is made from what’s shown
The list of which colour to pick in Google Calendar has gone
